reason: Sable Tide (101) left to find the source of the mysterious light at sea, leaving her old life behind.

citizen.name: Sable Tide
citizen.learned: Sable arrived in Vesper a year ago, seeking a quiet life away from her past. She found purpose in maintaining the lighthouse and ensuring the safety of the coastal town.
citizen.lifestyle: Early riser, dedicated to her work at the lighthouse. Spends evenings studying nautical maps and charts.
citizen.currently: Concerned about the recent sightings of mysterious lights at sea, Sable is determined to uncover their origin.

relationships: Sable and Cassius work together to ensure the smooth operation of the ferry and lighthouse.
Sable occasionally mentors Juno, sharing her knowledge of the tides and navigation.
Sable and Emmet often share stories of their experiences at sea.
Sable visits Halcyon for regular check-ups, but keeps their interactions professional.
